speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are here to discuss your acute diarrhea; to help you, I need to know how long you have been experiencing these symptoms and if you have noticed any blood or mucus in your stool.

speaker: Patient
text: 58-year-old female. The patient has been treated for community-acquired pneumonia with levofloxacin on the medical floor. She reports developing watery diarrhea with at least 9 episodes within the last two days, accompanied by lower abdominal discomfort and cramping.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Antibiotic-Associated Diarrhea (likely *C. difficile* infection). Given the recent treatment with levofloxacin for pneumonia and the onset of severe watery diarrhea, this is a classic presentation. I recommend immediate testing to confirm the diagnosis. REQUEST TEST: C. difficile toxin assay. REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_Pelvis_CT.
